contract.selective_unregister: unregister() removes only the matching callback for the specified plugin/event pair
contract.callback_isolation: Removing one callback does not remove other callbacks registered by the same plugin for the same event
contract.post_unregister_delivery: The removed callback receives no subsequent events
contract.remaining_callbacks: Other callbacks remain active and continue receiving events
contract.delivery_order: Remaining callbacks retain their original registration order
contract.registry_stability: Selective callback removal leaves the listener registry structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Selective unregister continues to require the events permission
